_comment: Ground truth from human-confirmed, vendor-reported findings (see disclosures/). Pinned by commit so lines do not drift. 'detected' records what the scanner reported on the measurement date; it is a measurement, not a label. No exploit strings belong in this file.

cases.verdict_note: Disclosure claims path traversal via zipfile.extractall. ZipFile._extract_member removes '..', '.', empty and drive/absolute components before joining the path (read in CPython v3.7.17, v3.11.9 and 3.14). The scanner correctly reports nothing here; do not count it as a miss.
cases.note: If an archive-extraction rule is ever added, it must model tarfile (no such stripping) separately from zipfile.

cases.missing: no PHP file-upload rule (client-supplied extension used in the stored file name, file moved to a public directory before validation)
Symfony HttpClient request($method, $url) is not a modelled SSRF sink; the URL arrives from another class, so cross-file taint is needed too

cases.detected_by: AST-CMD-003 (HIGH, taint unknown) after the argparse-to-eval change; missed before it
cases.note: Fixed upstream in the next commit; scan the pre-fix commit.
